name: MoYu Super RS3 M V2 MagLev UV 3x3
description: The RS3 M Super MagLev is MoYu's springless version of the new Super V2. This cube is UV coated and comes with traditional corner-edge magnets. Turning is fast and tactile. The RS3 isn't just a budget cube any longer, it is now a top contender. Try it and you will not be disappointed.
